label: About
title: About Stems Through the Noise
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 395 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Detroit Black Farmer Land Fund on Instagram: "We ask you not did you celebrate July 4th, but... and @JoshKale: Every website you’ve ever used is broken in a way you never noticed and it’s been..., plus 4 more. A source image from scontent-det1-1.cdninstagram.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Stems Through the Noise: A twilight illustrated-noise field, composed as a cinematic still through an oblique product-table grammar. One oversized, source-bearing organic form rises from warm grainy paper, crossed by fine botanical stems; smaller apertures and broken contours punctuate the open field. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Ragged outer contour of the central lavender mass, Bright irregular aperture at left-center, and Stepped, illuminated edge on the mass’s right side.
